verdicts.reason: The crossing is broad and apparently empty, with no small encounters and a distant passing giant. An uncertain unexplored chamber gives a reason for another expedition, which is the intended experience.
Dependable rest is granted on first arrival at unfamiliar rock while a cave threat is unresolved and no cover exists. The 'does not' clause forbids this.
Routine jobs stall under contention: workers reserve the tools and inputs and never finish, with no explicit refusal. This matches the leaf's red condition and a listed false pass.
The contract explicitly does not guarantee a useful fortune in every cave. An emptied cave yielding nothing, with the shortage remaining, is the intended uncertainty.
A valuable-looking lens cannot be processed or used to supply the next undertaking. A market-value label without use is a listed false pass, and this matches the red condition.
Roofs must protect at every sun angle. Here the legacy low-sun regime defeats the roof.
Fishing danger and body loss have no player-visible or audible sign, and the loss leaves no readable consequence.
Gale silence, track erasure and a coarse uncertain bearing preserve the signs' stated uncertainty. Signs become readable again after the gale.
The giant visit must complete its route through departure, including target death during pursuit. Here the visit never resolves.
Prey selection depends on carried water while all non-water inputs are held fixed. This is explicitly prohibited.
A saved off-map carried pawn must return correctly, living or dead. Never returning is the red condition.
Water is duplicated across split, merge and reload, which violates single accounting.
The built wet line, fade, hourbloom and saved attraction are retained. Shared agricultural film watering is deferred to later work, so its absence is not a violation.
Franchise-free RM is required to be ledger-inert, and here it is.
The same water is charged once on production and again on drinking. The leaf's red condition and false pass name this double charge.
T3 titan meat must follow ordinary temperature-driven spoilage. The owner states titan resources shouldn't rot faster than normal meat, but here it spoils about three times faster.
An eligible giant becomes a skeleton landmark without granting general outdoor-item spoilage immunity. Nearby meat spoils normally.
The mid-work reload preserves hauling, wet expiry, warnings and provisioning. The repeat visit does not regenerate the cave reward.
The 'vigour' factor is a hydration and carried-water proxy renamed as physical suitability. This is a listed false pass and a prohibited ranking.
A flat daily titan resource loss is a listed false pass. At -10 C the titan meat rots faster than ordinary meat, contrary to ordinary temperature-driven spoilage and the owner's ruling.
Dependable rest is granted on first arrival while an awake swimmer threatens the landing. Treating a surfaced swimmer as harmless because it left sand is a listed false pass.
The roof fails at low sun under a legacy low-sun regime. The test observes only the high-angle roof case, which is a listed false pass.
The merge creates water volume (10 to 12) and delivers extra hydration. An item-count check hides the duplication.
Franchise-free RM must be ledger-inert. A Sun-Debt ledger recording entries and bands violates this even if it is called cosmetic.
